in_hebrew.name: דן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: One who judges or discerns, especially in matters of right and wrong. The name Den is not found in the Bible, but the Hebrew word דן (dan) appears throughout the Old Testament, often referring to a judge or a place of judgment.

in_greek.name: Δέν
in_greek.long_meaning: Derived from the negative prefix Δε- (de-) meaning 'not', the name Den in Greek does not have a specific meaning on its own. It is not found in the New Testament.

in_latin.name: Denus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Denus in Latin is derived from the word denus, meaning 'hill' or 'high place'. It is not found in the Latin Vulgate, the authorized translation of the Bible into Latin.
